table_description: Activity reference table for the SAMPLE schema. One row per activity code — a short keyword and a human-readable description. The look-up side of EMP_ACT.ACTNO.
use_cases: Resolve an ACTNO from EMP_ACT to a human-readable activity description
Filter activities by keyword (ACTKWD) when building project-effort reports
Join into EMP_ACT to break down an employee's or project's time by activity
data_quality_notes: ACTNO is SMALLINT (numeric) — unlike most other identifiers in SAMPLE which are CHAR. Don't quote it in WHERE clauses.
ACTKWD is CHAR(6) — short code, may be padded with trailing spaces depending on how it's read. Use TRIM() if matching free-form input.
ACTDESC is VARCHAR(20) — short, so descriptions may abbreviate (e.g. 'DOCUMENT' for 'DOCUMENTATION').
The shipped sample contains a small fixed catalog of activities; new activities are added rarely.

table_columns.name: ACTNO
table_columns.description: Activity number, primary key. Numeric — compare without quotes.
